project_info.color_palette: Ice white, soft gray, pale blue, muted green, brand-specific accent color

main_subject.detail: A four-panel grid of translucent frosted paper-glass products, each paired with a restrained brand-color interaction: foaming Sprite bottle, liquid Chanel fragrance, cream-sculpture Nivea tin, and silent white earbuds.

composition_elements.text: FEEL CLEAR. STAY COOL.; TIME. ESSENCE. FOREVER.; PURE. CALM. BEAUTIFUL.; Silence Feels Like Magic
items: Upper left: green Sprite bottle with white foam, lemon, ice and slogan.
Upper right: translucent Chanel No. 5 bottle framed by flowing gold liquid.
Lower left: Nivea blue tin and tall white cream sculpture.
Lower right: pale earbuds, charging case, and soft concentric texture.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle contrast, ambient shadows, frosted transparency, glow/mist/liquid accents

assets.name: brand product packshot
assets.usage: Preserve the true silhouette, label, and brand materials inside the paper-glass interpretation.

assets.name: official brand logo
assets.usage: Render subtle etched, printed, or glowing identity without replacing it with generic text.

prompt_instructions: Attach exact product and official logo references.
Restrict each execution to one product and one single brand-color interaction.
Use the four-word slogan only when approved by the brand.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [ Product by Brand ] in a surreal, minimalist paper-glass style advertisement. The product is centered, crafted from translucent frosted glass-paper, placed against a clean white or softly tinted background. Soft cinematic lighting creates gentle contrast and ambient shadows. A single brand color subtly interacts with the scene through glow, mist, liquid, or foam. Include a bold, elegant 4-word slogan near the product. The brand logo appears subtly etched, glowing, or printed in a refined manner. Vertical or square aspect ratio, ultra-detailed, poster-quality, visually soothing and conceptually refined.
prompt.negative_prompt: opaque plastic, clutter, multiple accent colors, wrong logo, unreadable slogan, hard shadows, dark scene, low resolution, watermark
